learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn about different places in our town and the people around us!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A town has many places like schools, markets, and parks where we can go.
Many people live and work together in a town to make it a happy place.
The streets in the town are busy with cars, bicycles, and people walking.

fun_activity.title: 🗺️ Map of My Town
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a small map of your town. Include your house, a road, and your favorite park or shop!

quick_recap: ⭐ A town is a place where many people live.
⭐ There are markets, schools, and homes in a town.
⭐ The streets are always buzzing with activity.
